item.title: Night Shift Meal Prep: What to Pack for a 12-Hour Shift
item.description: Night shift meal prep made simple. Pack one main meal, two snacks and water, and use a cold bag and ice pack to keep food safe. A short guide for nurses and shift workers, with three sample packs. Guide contains affiliate links.
